03 / YOUR QUESTIONS

Know before
you book.

How much power will my vehicle gain?

There is no single figure for every vehicle. Engine version, fuel, condition and supporting hardware all matter. The Ranger artwork shows a Boostech application example; it is not a guaranteed result or a Bloemfontein customer case study.

Do I need an exhaust before a remap?

Many mechanically standard vehicles can use a suitable Stage 1 calibration. Whether an exhaust is worthwhile depends on your application and goals.

Is gearbox calibration available for every automatic?

No. Compatibility and the method used vary by vehicle. Share your exact model and transmission before deciding what work is appropriate.

What about an existing fault or modification?

Tell us about warning lights, mechanical concerns, an existing tuning box or previous software. These details are part of deciding whether the vehicle is ready for tuning.

What does it cost?

A quote depends on the vehicle, ECU access and requested work. Contact Boostech Bloemfontein for a vehicle-specific quote and booking availability.
